name: MO-07
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Eric Burlison running with large financial edge
Democrat Missi Hesketh raised only ~$50k with no outside support
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~96%
model.rationale: The R+21 district, Burlison's incumbency and roughly 29-to-1 fundraising advantage, and markets pricing a Republican win near 96% all point to a safe Republican hold with no contrary polling or ratings evidence.
model.watch: A late surge of outside Democratic spending or a polling surprise showing Hesketh within single digits would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Southwest Missouri's 7th District is deeply Republican, with a partisan lean of about 21 points toward the GOP. First-term incumbent Eric Burlison was renominated and enters the general election with roughly $958,000 on hand, while Democrat Missi Hesketh has raised about $50,000 and has no visible outside support. A Libertarian is also on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Burlison about a 96% chance of winning. With the incumbent's financial edge and the district's strong Republican tilt, this seat is rated Safe Republican, with only a small chance of an upset.
